name: CI Agent Audit
description: Finds fork-triggerable CI agents that can write to your repo. Runs nothing.
about: Point it at a repo or a workflow file. The grackle scanner finds GitHub Actions and GitLab CI jobs where an untrusted fork pull request can reach a coding agent that holds a write token, then the bot reads the surrounding workflow and rules on each hit. It explains the trust path and the fix, and never runs anything from the workflows.
features: Flag agents a fork PR can drive with write access
Rule on every scanner hit, with the trust path
Explain the gate or checkout change that fixes it
examplePrompt: Audit the workflows in this repo. Can an outside pull request reach a coding agent that can write to the repo?
